name: feishu-mcp
description: Feishu / Lark (messaging): me, list_inbound, get_thread, send, reply. Every tool maps to a documente

platform_mcp_feishu_app_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FEISHU_APP_ID
platform_mcp_feishu_app_id.description: App ID of a Feishu custom (self-built) app with the bot capability (cli_…); exchanged with app_secret at POST /open-apis/auth/v3/tenant_access_token/internal for a tenant_access_token (max 2 hours).

platform_mcp_feishu_app_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FEISHU_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_feishu_app_secret.description: App Secret of the same app (developer console, Credentials & Basic Info).

platform_mcp_feishu_receive_id_type.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FEISHU_RECEIVE_ID_TYPE
platform_mcp_feishu_receive_id_type.description: How `send`'s `to` is interpreted (receive_id_type query parameter): chat_id (group or p2p chat oc_…, the usual choice), open_id, union_id, user_id or email. Set it to chat_id unless you address users directly.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Bot info: account.bot carries app_name, open_id, activate_status. Needs the bot capability enabled.

tools.name: list_inbound
tools.description: History of ONE chat (`channel` = chat_id oc_…, required; the bot must be in the chat), newest first; page_size 1–50. text is body.content, a JSON string such as {"text":"…"}; sent_at is create_time in milliseconds. Paging is by page_token, so `page` is ignored; `since` is not sent (start_time takes Unix seconds).

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: All messages of a topic thread (`thread_id` = omt_… from a message's thread_id), oldest first; `page` is ignored.

tools.name: send
tools.description: Text message to `to`, interpreted per config receive_id_type (chat_id oc_… by default choice; the bot must be in the chat, or the user within the app's availability scope). `content` is sent as the serialized JSON string {"text": …} the API requires; `uuid` de-duplicates retries. `subject`/`channel` are ignored.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Replies to the message `thread_id` (a message id om_…, e.g. a list_inbound id) with a text message; `channel` is not needed.
